text:
alia: Quick note 1 PR #6001 updates the Kubernetes quickstart for the hello-world app. Main changes: move API key into a k8s Secret, recommend using a service account with minimal permissions, and add a short migration note for SDK v6.

ben: Love the Secret move. Can you paste the k8s manifest snippet so I can check the env refs?

alia: Sure, pushed this minimal snippet:

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: redwood-secret
type: Opaque
data:
  REDWOOD_API_KEY: <base64-key>
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
# container env: valueFrom.secretKeyRef: { name: redwood-secret, key: REDWOOD_API_KEY }
```

raj: tiny nit: avoid including `<base64-key>` literally in examples; use `REDWOOD_API_KEY_BASE64_PLACEHOLDER` or show `echo -n \"$KEY\" | base64`. Otherwise lgtm.

emi: Also add a one-liner about RBAC: suggest creating a minimal service account and binding only get/list for relevant resources. Link to our k8s security page.

alia: Good call. I'll replace the placeholder and add the RBAC link + a short migration blurb: "SDK v5 -> v6: client constructor changed; update import path and constructor args (see migration guide)."

ben: Can we also recommend `kubectl create secret generic redwood-secret --from-literal=REDWOOD_API_KEY=$KEY` in the README? Many folks find the base64 step confusing.

raj: And a troubleshooting note: if you see 401s, check that the secret is in the same namespace and the deployment env var name matches.

docs-bot: Preview build for PR #6001: https://deploy-preview.redwood-docs/pr-6001  build succeeded :white_check_mark:

alia: Thanks all. I'll push the edits (placeholder -> cli example, RBAC snippet, migration line). If no other blockers I'll merge after the minor copyfix.
